exchanges: good morning dear, up early as usual
Good morning, early starts can be lovely.
was out birdwatching at dawn, saw a heron
What a wonderful sight to start the day.
my nephew is studying dentistry now, cant believe it
That's a big step, the family must be proud.
seems like yesterday he was in nappies
They grow up so fast.
my husband anselm burnt the toast again, every single morning
Ha, some traditions are hard to break.
i dont have the heart to tell him
That's very kind of you.
took our dog juniper round the reservoir, she was knackered after
Sounds like a lovely long walk.
the weather is turning though
Time to dig out the warm coats.
my niece has picked linguistics, she always loved languages
That suits her perfectly then.
she speaks better french than me already
That's impressive.
the vet says our old basset is getting a bit chubby
Maybe fewer treats and a few more walks.
easier said than done with those eyes
Those pleading looks are hard to resist.
my husband insists on lanterna every friday, he loves their carbonara
Having a favourite spot is a nice routine.
i would try somewhere new but he wont budge
Maybe a compromise on special occasions.
my old colleague wendell popped round for tea, hadnt seen him in ages
How lovely to reconnect.
we talked for hours about the old school days
Sounds like a wonderful afternoon.
knee is playing up, gp thinks its bursitis
That sounds sore, I hope rest helps.
so no long rambles for a bit
Your knee will thank you for the rest.
my neighbour gwyneth is moving to anglesey, ill miss her terribly
That's sad, but you can always visit her.
she's been next door for years
That's a real friendship to have nearby.
my nephew is settling in well at carrowmore, rings every sunday
Good that he keeps in touch.
made a lemon drizzle cake this afternoon
That sounds delicious.
gwyneth lent me rebecca before she goes, i cant put it down
A gripping read is the best kind.
right, time for my programme
Enjoy your evening.
